sunday.title: 5th Sunday of Easter
sunday.weeklyTruth: The Eucharist forms us to become a gift.
sunday.practice: Offer one hidden act of charity this week.
sunday.familyQuestion: How can our home become more like the Mass?

readings.label: First Reading
readings.summary: The early Church is strengthened in faith.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.summary: I will praise your name forever, my King.

readings.label: Second Reading
readings.summary: A new heaven and a new earth.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.summary: Love one another as I have loved you.

notice.title: The altar
notice.body: It is the place of sacrifice, not a stage.

notice.title: The Offertory
notice.body: We offer our gifts — and ourselves — with Christ.

notice.title: The Eucharist
notice.body: The Lord gives Himself to us completely.

massSections.title: The Offertory
massSections.main: With these gifts, we offer ourselves with Christ.
massSections.detail: We unite our offering to the sacrifice of Jesus on the cross.
massSections.what: Bread and wine are brought to the altar. They will become the Body and Blood of Christ.
massSections.why: Our gifts are joined to Jesus’ sacrifice. We offer ourselves with Him.
massSections.how: Offer your week, your family, your work, your suffering.

massSections.title: Liturgy of the Word
massSections.detail: Listen with the heart of the Church.

massSections.title: Eucharistic Prayer
massSections.main: The Church offers praise and thanksgiving.
massSections.detail: We are drawn into Christ’s offering to the Father.
